start.speaker: dalia
start.text: Oh, sorry, we're in your way. Ilo, sit down, love. He hasn't spoken since we left the surface. He keeps looking at the hull like it's going to open.

choices.text: Hey, Ilo. Ships like this are built to take a beating. I've seen worse hold together.
(In Haldis dialect) Little sparrow, the sky only looks big from the ground.
Keep him close and keep out of the way if anything happens.

kind.speaker: dalia
kind.text: Did you hear that, Ilo? The operator says so. Thank you. You don't know what that face does to me.

dialect.speaker: narrator
dialect.text: Ilo's head snaps around at the sound of home. For the first time since you sat down, he almost smiles.

effects.reason: Reached Ilo in his own language

dialect2.speaker: dalia
dialect2.text: You're from the Reach. And you flew for the Lattice. I worked for the Concord too. A clerk. Nobody asks clerks what they signed.

practical.speaker: dalia
practical.text: Out of the way. Yes. That's been our whole war.

where.speaker: dalia
where.text: Tessaly. My sister's there. I filed Concord paperwork for nine years on Haldis, and now the Assembly calls me a collaborator and the Concord calls me a refugee. Ilo just calls me tired.

choices.text: For what it's worth, I hope Tessaly is kind to you both.
The Concord owes you. Make them pay it.

again.speaker: dalia
again.text: Ilo's drawing ships now. That's an improvement.

after.speaker: dalia
after.text: What's happening? The announcement said obstructions, what does that mean, are we obstructions? Ilo, Ilo, look at me.

choices.text: Stay with Purser Dray at the muster point. I promise I'll clear the way to the launch craft.
Stay here and stay down. That's all I can tell you.
I don't know. Nobody does. Keep him quiet.

promise.speaker: dalia
promise.text: You promise. All right. All right, Ilo, the operator promised.

down.speaker: dalia
down.text: Down. We know how to do down.

after2.speaker: dalia
after2.text: We're staying with Dray. Go. Please.
